dataRetention.title: Retenção de dados
dataRetention.subtitle: How long each dataset is kept, and when its records stop costing local disk.
dataRetention.keepHint: A record is deleted this many days after it happened, wherever it is stored by then.
dataRetention.coldHint: Older records move to object storage and stay queryable. 0 keeps everything on local disk.
dataRetention.coldUnavailable: Set up cold storage below to move older records off local disk.
dataRetention.coldBeforeDelete: Records have to move before they are deleted: use fewer days than the lifetime, or 0.
dataRetention.tieredNote: This dataset moves records to cold storage. Going back to local-only needs the table rebuilt, so it cannot be turned off here.

toast.noPermission: You do not have permission to change retention

coldStorage.title: Cold storage
coldStorage.hint: An object store the event store treats as a second, slower disk. Older records move there and are still queried from the same place — it is not an archive and nothing has to be restored.
coldStorage.writtenNotReady: The bucket is configured but the store has not picked it up. Check that the deployment shares the store's configuration directory.
coldStorage.bucketLocked: The credentials can be changed at any time. The bucket cannot, once records live in it: the parts already moved carry it.
coldStorage.kind_s3: Armazenamento de objetos compatível com S3
coldStorage.useRole: Usar a função IAM do servidor em vez de chaves
coldStorage.s3Hint: Funciona com AWS S3 e qualquer armazenamento compatível com S3: MinIO, Ceph, Wasabi, Cloudflare R2 ou Google Cloud Storage (endpoint https://storage.googleapis.com/<bucket>/ com chaves HMAC).
coldStorage.localHint: Os registros vão para a pasta montada em /mnt/utmstack-cold dentro do armazenamento de eventos: um diretório comum na pasta de dados, ou um compartilhamento NFS montado no host sobre <diretório de dados>/clickhouse/cold antes de iniciar o stack. Não exige credenciais.
coldStorage.changeWarning: Records already moved to the current destination are not migrated. They stay there and stop being readable from here until the old destination is copied across by hand.

forbidden.title: Esta página é da plataforma
forbidden.body: A retenção se aplica às tabelas que todos os tenants compartilham, então só um administrador da plataforma pode lê-la ou alterá-la.
